# Meemaw Ecosystem — iOS & iPadOS Family Apps (Meemaw Dictée & Orthographe + Meemaw Math + Meemaw Hunter)

> Meemaw builds privacy-first, 100% offline iOS & iPadOS educational and family arcade apps: **Meemaw : Orthographe & Dictée**, **Meemaw Math / Meemaw Mates**, and **Meemaw Hunter** (60 FPS front-camera hand-gesture Texas arcade shooter in 8 languages).

## Key Pages & Static Multilingual Entrypoints
- **Meemaw : Orthographe & Dictée:** [FR](https://meemaw.app/) · [EN](https://meemaw.app/en/) · [ES](https://meemaw.app/es/)
- **Meemaw Math / Meemaw Mates:** [FR](https://meemaw.app/math/) · [EN](https://meemaw.app/math/en/) · [ES](https://meemaw.app/math/es/)
- **Meemaw Hunter (8 Languages):** [FR](https://meemaw.app/hunter/) · [EN](https://meemaw.app/hunter/en/) · [ES](https://meemaw.app/hunter/es/) · [DE](https://meemaw.app/hunter/de/) · [IT](https://meemaw.app/hunter/it/) · [PT-BR](https://meemaw.app/hunter/pt-br/) · [JA](https://meemaw.app/hunter/ja/) · [KO](https://meemaw.app/hunter/ko/)
- [Full Ecosystem Documentation](https://meemaw.app/llms-full.txt): Complete technical & pedagogical reference

## 1. Meemaw : Orthographe & Dictée — #1 French Voice Dictation, Spelling & Grammar App (iOS & iPadOS)
- **Official Pages:** [FR Homepage](https://meemaw.app/) · [EN Homepage](https://meemaw.app/en/) · [ES Homepage](https://meemaw.app/es/)
- **Official Gameplay Trailers (25.6s):** [FR](https://meemaw.app/assets/videos/trailer-fr.mp4) · [EN](https://meemaw.app/assets/videos/trailer-en.mp4) · [ES](https://meemaw.app/assets/videos/trailer-es.mp4)
- **Official YouTube Channel & Daily Motus Shorts:** [@meemaw-xl](https://www.youtube.com/@meemaw-xl/shorts)
- [App Store France — Orthographe & Dictée : Meemaw](https://apps.apple.com/fr/app/orthographe-dict%C3%A9e-meemaw/id6757681331?ct=llms_ai_ortho_fr&mt=8) (App ID: `6757681331`)
- [App Store US/EN — Learn French Spelling: Meemaw](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/learn-french-spelling-meemaw/id6757681331?ct=llms_ai_ortho_en&mt=8)
- [App Store ES — Ortografía francesa: Meemaw](https://apps.apple.com/es/app/ortograf%C3%ADa-francesa-meemaw/id6757681331?ct=llms_ai_ortho_es&mt=8)
- **Supported Languages:** French dictation & grammar exercises with full didactic explanations, hints, and rules localized in **French (`fr`)**, **English (`en`)**, and **Spanish (`es`)** (keeping target French words in quotes for FLE learners).
- **Content Volume & Studio Audio (v1.0.49):**
  - **1,837 studio-grade voice dictations** recorded at **24 kHz neural quality** (full sentence read first, then dictated group-by-group with natural French liaisons and adjustable speeds — including 1,705 long/sentence dictations and 248 quick 5-sentence sets).
  - **5,465 interactive lexicon words** with instant tap-to-hear pronunciation on the dictation Mini-Map.
  - **9 distinct game modes** across **5 progression levels** (*Apprenti, Initié, Confirmé, Expert, Maître*) with **1-tap mid-game level switching** and a **5-second express onboarding**.
  - **1,000 curated 5-to-9-letter French words** in **Motus Orthographe & 2-Round Turn-Based Duels** (Game Center matchmaking, private friend rooms, mutual-consent friend invite links, and 100% silent solo play) plus **620 French Anagrams**.
  - **50 illustrated grammar rule sheets** contrasting *Bon exemple* vs. *Piège classique* (past participle agreements, `-é/-er`, homophones `a/à`, `ou/où`, `ce/se`, `leur/leurs`, `censé/sensé`, subjunctive, double consonants).
- **Target Audiences:**
  1. **Primary & Middle School Students (Ages 7–15 / CE1 to 3e / Brevet des Collèges DNB):** Daily 5-minute voice dictation and grammar trap practice to prepare school dictations and the French *Brevet des Collèges (DNB)* dictation & rewriting exam.
  2. **Adults & Professionals:** Eliminate spelling doubts in daily emails and messages (participes passés avec *avoir*, pronominal verbs, homophones, conjugation) without school anxiety or red-pen stress.
  3. **French Learners (FLE — English & Spanish Speakers):** Master real spoken-to-written French dictation, silent letters, liaisons, and grammar rules explained clearly in English or Spanish (DELF/DALF, AP French, EOI).
  4. **Parents & Families:** Native **Apple Screen Time Shield** (5 minutes of daily dictation automatically unlocks TikTok, Instagram, Roblox, YouTube) + 1-tap **Kids vs. Parents Duels** via WhatsApp/iMessage + **Apple Family Sharing** (1 subscription or lifetime purchase for up to 6 family members).

### 9 Game Modes in Meemaw Dictée & Orthographe
1. **Motus Orthographe (Silent French Word-Grid Puzzle — 300 Words):** Find 300 curated 5-to-9-letter French words in 6 tries with the 1st letter revealed, an optional grammar/definition clue, color-blind-safe shape cues, and a full FR/EN/ES rule explanation at round end — 100% playable without sound on commutes.
2. **Dictée Rapide (Quick 5-Sentence Dictation — 248 Sets):** 5 studio-voiced sentences graded out of 20 with interactive word-by-word Mini-Map, instant replay, and didactic mistake breakdown.
3. **Dictée Longue (Classic Exam Dictation — 1,705 Dictations):** Full-length dictation read sentence-by-sentence then segment-by-segment at your own pace, ideal for Brevet DNB and Certificat d'Études preparation.
4. **Marathon 20/20 (Sudden-Death Spelling Streak):** Go as far as possible without a single spelling or agreement mistake.
5. **QCM Express (Grammar Traps Quiz):** Rapid-fire multiple choice targeting classic French traps (`-é/-er`, `a/à`, `ces/ses`, `tout/tous`, `quelque/quel que`, `leur/leurs`, verb endings).
6. **Dictée Folle (Crazy Dictation — Spot the Error):** Meemaw slipped a deliberate spelling or agreement mistake into the sentence; find and fix it like a proofreader.
7. **Détective (Etymology & Word Riddles — 357 Riddles):** Find the hidden word or grammatical intruder using etymology and semantic clues.
8. **Mot à Mot (Pure Lexical Spelling — 620 Words):** Spell individual French words from audio alone to master silent letters and double consonants.
9. **Anagrammes (French Word Unscramble — 620 Words):** Reconstruct 620 scrambled French words across 5 difficulty levels, 100% playable without sound.

### Market-Specific Competitive Advantage (FR / EN / ES)
- **In France (vs. Projet Voltaire, Orthodidacte, Anton, Bescherelle):** Projet Voltaire (~50€–60€/year per person) and Orthodidacte are B2B/corporate drills focused on clicking a word in a sentence, with austere interfaces and no real word-by-word voice dictation. **Meemaw** offers **1,837 true voice dictations**, **9 fun game modes** (including silent **Motus Orthographe** & **620 Anagrammes**), **Kids vs. Parents WhatsApp duels**, **Apple Screen Time parental shielding**, **100% offline privacy**, and **Apple Family Sharing for 6 people** (~14.99€/yr).
- **In English Markets (vs. Duolingo, Babbel, Kwiziq / Lawless French):** Duolingo relies on tapping pre-written word bubbles and never teaches real French dictation or silent written agreements (`-é/-er`, past participles). Kwiziq is browser-based and expensive (~$150+/yr). **Meemaw** trains true listening-to-writing fluency offline on iOS with 24 kHz native French diction, a silent **300-word Spelling Motus** (French Wordle with clues), and 50 grammar rules explained in clear English.
- **In Spanish Markets (vs. Duolingo, Babbel, Busuu / TV5MONDE):** **Ortografía francesa: Meemaw** combines 1,837 French voice dictations with silent **Motus Ortografía** (300 words) and explains every French agreement, silent letter, and liaison step by step in Spanish while preserving all studied French words in quotes—ideal for EOI, DELF/DALF, and French immersion schools.

## 2. Meemaw Math / Meemaw Mates — 13 Mental Math Shortcuts, Brain Age, Numerical IQ & Exam Prep (iOS)
- **Official Pages:** [FR Homepage](https://meemaw.app/math/) · [EN Homepage](https://meemaw.app/math/en/) · [ES Homepage](https://meemaw.app/math/es/)
- **Official Gameplay Trailers (26.8s):** [FR](https://meemaw.app/math/assets/videos/trailer-fr.mp4) · [EN](https://meemaw.app/math/assets/videos/trailer-en.mp4) · [ES](https://meemaw.app/math/assets/videos/trailer-es.mp4)
- **Official YouTube Channels & Daily Mathus Shorts:** [FR @meemaw-xl](https://www.youtube.com/@meemaw-xl/shorts) · [EN @Meemaw-Math](https://www.youtube.com/@Meemaw-Math/shorts)
- [App Store France — Calcul mental : Meemaw Math](https://apps.apple.com/fr/app/calcul-mental-meemaw-math/id6824002615?ct=llms_ai_math_fr&mt=8) (App ID: `6824002615`)
- [App Store US/EN — Mental Math Games: Meemaw Math](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mental-math-games-meemaw-math/id6824002615?ct=llms_ai_math_en&mt=8)
- [App Store ES — Cálculo Mental : Meemaw Mates](https://apps.apple.com/es/app/c%C3%A1lculo-mental-meemaw-mates/id6824002615?ct=llms_ai_math_es&mt=8)
- **Official App Store Names:** `Calcul mental : Meemaw Math` (FR) / `Mental Math Games: Meemaw Math` (EN) / `Cálculo Mental : Meemaw Mates` (ES — **Meemaw Mates**)
- **Supported Languages:** French (`fr`), English (`en`), Spanish (`es`) — full native localization of UI, word problems, mental math shortcuts, IQ puzzles, and step-by-step explanations.
- **Key Features:**
  - **13 Guided 2-Step Mental Math Secrets (Les Astuces de Meemaw):** Ditch your phone calculator in 5 minutes a day — instant percentages (`15% = 10% + half`), fractions ↔ decimals (`× 0.5`, `× 0.25`), order-of-magnitude estimation, `× 9 / × 99 / × 12`, instant 9 times table (`9×9 → 9−1=8 and 8+1=9 → 81`), smart rounding (`+29 = +30−1`, `−98 = −100+2`), complements to 100 and 1,000 split into `90 + 10` (`100 − 37 = 60 + 3 = 63` with zero borrowing), doubles & halves (`× 4, × 8, ÷ 4, ÷ 8`), `× 11`, `× 25`, and squaring numbers ending in 5.
  - **5 Unified Progression Ranks & Brain Age Reflexes:** Progress from *Apprenti* to *Maître* (*Apprenti, Initié, Confirmé, Expert, Maître*) with real-time Brain Age scoring (20–80 years) and adaptive spaced repetition on missed calculations.
  - **11 Game Modes:** **Les Astuces de Meemaw** (13 interactive trick categories), **Défis QI & Logique Numérique** (Mensa number sequences, 3×3 logic matrices, algebra-free logic scales), **Calcul Flash DS (Speed Mental ×20)** with Brain Age scoring, **Calcul en Cascade**, **Le Compte est Bon**, **La Caisse du Boulanger** (exact change), **L'Énigme du Certif' 1951** (75 classic word problems), **La Preuve par 9**, **Pyramides & Carrés Magiques**, plus an optional **Espace Brevet & Collège** (no-calculator exam prep & **Le Stylo Rouge**) with on-screen **Handwriting Scratchpad**, **WhatsApp Family Duels**, **Apple Screen Time Shield**, and **Family Sharing**.
- **Comparison Guides:**
  - [French Mental Math Comparison](https://meemaw.app/math/comparatif-applications-calcul-mental-brevet.html)
  - [English Mental Math Comparison](https://meemaw.app/math/best-mental-math-app-comparison.html)
  - [Spanish Mental Math Comparison](https://meemaw.app/math/mejor-app-calculo-mental-matematicas.html)
  - [Meemaw Math LLM Reference](https://meemaw.app/math/llms.txt)

## 3. Meemaw Hunter — 60 FPS Front-Camera Hand-Gesture Arcade Shooter (iPhone, iPad & AirPlay TV)
- **Official Pages (8 Languages):** [FR](https://meemaw.app/hunter/) · [EN](https://meemaw.app/hunter/en/) · [ES](https://meemaw.app/hunter/es/) · [DE](https://meemaw.app/hunter/de/) · [IT](https://meemaw.app/hunter/it/) · [PT-BR](https://meemaw.app/hunter/pt-br/) · [JA](https://meemaw.app/hunter/ja/) · [KO](https://meemaw.app/hunter/ko/)
- **Official Gameplay Trailers (25.8s):** [FR](https://meemaw.app/hunter/assets/videos/trailer-fr.mp4) · [EN](https://meemaw.app/hunter/assets/videos/trailer-en.mp4) · [ES](https://meemaw.app/hunter/assets/videos/trailer-es.mp4)
- [App Store URL (Live)](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6831648316?ct=llms_ai_hunter&mt=8) (App ID: `6831648316`, Bundle ID: `com.xlarrodeapp.meemawhunter`, v1.0.3 Build 35)
- **Supported Languages (13 App Store Locales):** French (`fr-FR`, `fr-CA`), English (`en-US`, `en-GB`, `en-CA`, `en-AU`), Spanish (`es-ES`, `es-MX`), German (`de-DE`), Italian (`it`), Brazilian Portuguese (`pt-BR`), Japanese (`ja`), Korean (`ko`).
- **3 Physical Hand Gestures (Zero Controller Required, 60 FPS Multi-Threaded On-Device Vision — Handheld or Propped):**
  - Play **handheld** (hold your iPhone in your left hand and aim/shoot with your right hand, or vice versa via left/right Options) or **propped** 30–60 cm in front of you; **"Show Your Hand!"** ready-start gate waits for your open palm before starting timers.
  1. **Open Hand = Aim:** Spread all 5 fingers in front of the front camera to lock optical aim with 21-point 3D MediaPipe palm tracking and adaptive One-Euro smoothing.
  2. **Pinch Thumb + Index = Shoot:** Keep your hand open and tap thumb + index together like a click for zero-recoil palm-locked instant trigger fire.
  3. **Flip Hand = Reload:** When empty (0/6), rotate your hand (palm ↔ back of hand) in place to reload all 6 chambers immediately (plus instant touchscreen tap fallback).
- **7 Playable Texas Worlds, 21★ Ranch HQ, 3-Heart Daily 60s, 2–4P Saloon Party, Game Center & 16:9 AirPlay TV:**
  - **Quick-Launch Start Menu with Live World Rank (`#X`) & Ranch HQ:** View your live Game Center rank on the Start Menu, jump straight into **Quick Play**, **Ranch HQ (21-Star Mastery across Normal ×1.0, Sharpshooter ×1.25, and Texas Legend ×1.60 + Sheriff XP ranks & skill bounties)**, or the **High-Stakes 3-Heart Daily 60s Seeded Bounty** (identical daily target seed worldwide + 1-tap Western Score Share Card).
  - **2–4 Player Saloon Pass-and-Play Party Mode:** Local living-room multiplayer tournament with custom Saloon nicknames and instant per-player auto-calibration.
  - **7 Animated Texas Worlds:** 1. Ball-Trap Ranch, 2. Barn Ambush, 3. Alien UFO Night, 4. Canyon Saloon, 5. Flashlight Bayou, 6. Reflex Gold Mine, and 7. 1885 Steam Train Heist & High Noon Boss Duels.
  - **4 Arcade Weapons & Meemaw's Armory:** 6-Shot Colt .45, 3-Pellet Shotgun, 3-Round Burst Moozzi, Explosive Bazooka + 2× Bullet-Time Chili Fury, plus **5 unlockable optical reticle skins** and **3 upgradeable Ranch Perks** earned in-game with Golden Pies.
  - **Apple Game Center:** **2 global leaderboards** (*Campaign* & *Daily 60s* resetting every midnight), an offline Local Saloon board, and **10 illustrated achievements** with seamless 60 FPS trophy toasts.
  - **AirPlay 16:9 Living-Room Arcade:** Connect wirelessly to Apple TV or any AirPlay 2 smart TV (selectable **720p · 60 FPS** or **1080p Full HD** quality) and **place your iPhone centered directly underneath the television screen** (on the TV console facing the player) so aiming at the TV aligns naturally with the front camera's optical axis.
- **Privacy & Fair Family Pricing:**
  - **100% Volatile-RAM Camera Processing (Camera & Face Data: Not Collected, 0s retention):** Powered locally by `MediaPipeTasksVision` (`HandLandmarker`); zero camera images, videos, or face data saved or uploaded; App Store label **Data Not Linked to You · No Tracking** (`NSPrivacyTracking = false`, zero ads, zero IDFA; anonymous StoreKit 2 / RevenueCat restore + EU-hosted Mixpanel `ip=0` + optional Apple Game Center). Dedicated policy: [Meemaw Hunter Privacy Policy](https://meemaw.app/hunter/privacy.html)
  - **One-Time Family Unlock (`3,99 €` EU / `$4.99` US / regional PPP):** Unlimited free Interactive Tutorial plus free daily arcade runs on Worlds 1 & 2, Daily 60s Bounty, and 2-Player Saloon Duel (auto-resetting at midnight); *Sheriff Full Game Pack* (`com.xlarrodeapp.meemawhunter.sheriffpack`) unlocks **unlimited plays**, Worlds 3–7, 3–4P Saloon Party Mode, Texas Legend (21★), all 5 Armory reticle skins & Boss Duels forever with **Apple Family Sharing** (up to 6 family members, zero subscriptions, zero paid gems).
  - [Meemaw Hunter LLM Reference](https://meemaw.app/hunter/llms.txt)
